The '''Bilbringi [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] fields''' that surrounded the [[Bilbringi Shipyards]] made the shipyards there almost unassailable. The only way to mount an attack was to jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and then revert to [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] inside the perimeter. During the early days of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], this maneuver was tried. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] piloted by [[Quip Fargil]] was meant to impact with the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]], the ''Falcon'' was carrying a [[Baradium fission device]]. Using the ''Falcon''{{'s}} exceptional [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] he could jump bypass the asteroid fields. The mission was a failure because Fargil couldn't bear to destroy the ''Falcon'', he jumped to [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]] before reaching the shipyards.
